page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. This CPU features 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz, supported by a 35 MB L3 cache. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The virtualization is managed via a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple tests. It achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, alongside a write speed of 48.22 GB/sec. In application-specific benchmarks, the server handles 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second and delivers a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec. For language model tasks, it processes 1539.55 tokens per second for a small 135M model prompt, but drops to 45.98 tokens per second for a medium 7B model.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge provides a balanced resource density of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU, making it suitable for workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The lack of bundled local storage means users must factor in the latency and cost of network storage. Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, this instance is appropriate for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, database operations, and web serving.
